evaluations.output:
```lua
local Vec2 = {}
Vec2.__index = Vec2

function Vec2.new(x, y)
    local self = setmetatable({}, Vec2)
    self.x = x or 0.0
    self.y = y or 0.0
    return self
end

function Vec2:scale(factor)
    self.x = self.x * factor
    self.y = self.y * factor
    return self
end

return Vec2
```
